I’m an actor on a current movie in production, to be released in the next year or two. We do filming way in advance, and then there’s editing, reshoots, marketing campaigns to be thought up and promos to shoot. All that to say, we are still filming 

But there have been some difficulties along the way. For the sake of this story, I’m Chris (No, not Hemsworth, Evans, Pine, Pratt, or any others you can think of). And my costar will be called Ana. The director shall also remain anonymous, as even alluding to who they might be can get you blacklisted in this industry. But let me be clear: he is a massive perfectionist prick.

When I say perfectionist I don’t mean we need to have the sets perfect and the lines and marks exactly right. I mean that he will have us run the same shot 50 times or more if he doesn’t like it. Tweaking it and our directions over and over until all of us are blue in the face. He’s obsessed with realism and authenticity. When me and Ana both got cast for the movie, we both knew we would be love interests who eventually slept together in the movie. 

The director wasn’t satisfied with our acting credentials or our screen tests together. He wanted to make sure we had true chemistry. Somehow he got the studio to green light paying for us to go on multiple dates and a retreat together to try and bond for the sake of the emotional connection between characters. That might sound really nice, getting by to spend a paid for retreat with your beautiful costar. 

The problem was neither of us were interested. Don’t get me wrong, Ana is absolutely a bombshell. She’s got a figure that fills out a dress as much as it fills seats at the box office, an amazing smile and beautiful hair. She’s a leading film actress and model. Of course she’s beautiful. She’s also down to earth, funny, a hard worker, and as best as I can tell, a generally nice person.   
She’s also a professional. 

Neither of us are interested in mixing business and pleasure, which is funny considering we work in an industry where half the couples on the red carpet met on set or during a collaboration. We came to do a job, bring our A-game, act the hell out of the script, and go home. It isn’t that we aren’t friendly, I think it’s safe to say we are good friends now. But we also like to keep things professional. To us, the whole song and dance of going on dates and a retreat felt like a heavy-handed attempt by the studio or our agents to play matchmaker and stir up some buzz that we were falling in love on the set of our new movie.  

Ana is lovely and I would totally be open to dating her \*after\* we had finished shooting. But the feeling of being pushed together by the studio for the sake of free promotional material and gossip felt unprofessional and gross. Neither of us were interested in being promotional pawns, as ironic as that sounds. Have us shoot the movie, do the promo photos and posters, do hundreds to thousands of interviews with every network and on tour and maybe even at cons. But don’t jerk us around by trying to have us fall in love on your movie set as a promotional tool. 

Not saying that doesn’t happen, because it absolutely does. There are an endless stream of fake relationships, beefs, flings, and coordinated “oops” moments “caught” by paparazzi (or an “anonymous source”) to generate attention, buzz, and free marketing. The main difference here was that neither of us had been approached about it being an official thing the studio wanted, and was willing to pay for in our contracts. 

Both of us could feel the pressure and talked about it. We were in agreement that although our dates had gone well, we weren’t going to give the studio anything more than they paid for. Despite our mutual attraction, we were going to do our best in every scene, and go home. If things progressed after that, then great.

我的搭档叫我在镜头前真正操她 (M28/F24)

我是一部正在制作的电影的演员，该电影将在未来一两年内上映。我们提前进行拍摄，然后进行剪辑、重拍、构思营销活动和拍摄宣传片。话虽如此，我们仍在拍摄中

但一路上也遇到了一些困难。在这个故事中，我是克里斯（不，不是海姆斯沃斯、埃文斯、派恩、普拉特或任何你能想到的其他人）。我的搭档叫安娜。董事也应保持匿名，因为即使暗示他们可能是谁，也可能会让您被列入该行业的黑名单。但让我明确一点：他是一个完美主义者。

当我说完美主义者时，我并不是说我们需要让布景完美、线条和标记完全正确。我的意思是，如果他不喜欢的话，他会让我们对同一个镜头进行 50 次或更多次。一遍又一遍地调整它和我们的方向，直到我们所有人都脸色发青。他痴迷于现实主义和真实性。当我和安娜都被选为这部电影的演员时，我们都知道我们会成为爱情对象，最终在电影中睡在一起。

导演对我们的演技或一起试镜并不满意。他想确保我们有真正的化学反应。不知何故，他让工作室开了绿灯，出钱让我们一起进行多次约会和静修，以尝试建立联系，以建立角色之间的情感联系。与美丽的搭档一起享受付费静修，这听起来可能真的很不错。

问题是我们都不感兴趣。别误会我的意思，安娜绝对是一个重磅炸弹。她的身材就像填满了裙子一样，也填满了票房座位，她有着令人惊叹的微笑和美丽的头发。她是一位领先的电影女演员和模特。她当然很漂亮。她还脚踏实地、有趣、工作努力，而且据我所知，她总体上是一个很好的人。
她也是一名专业人士。

我们俩都不热衷于把工作和娱乐混在一起，考虑到我们工作的行业中有一半红地毯上的情侣是在片场或合作期间认识的，这很有趣。我们来这里是为了做一份工作，拿出我们的最佳表现，按照剧本表演，然后回家。并不是说我们不友好，我想可以肯定地说我们现在是好朋友了。但我们也希望保持专业性。对我们来说，约会和静修的整个歌舞感觉就像工作室或我们的经纪人在扮演媒人并激起一些关于我们在新电影片场坠入爱河的热议。

安娜很可爱，我完全愿意在我们完成拍摄后与她约会。但为了免费的宣传材料和八卦而被工作室推到一起的感觉感觉不专业和恶心。我们俩都没有兴趣成为促销棋子，这听起来很讽刺。让我们拍摄电影，制作宣传照片和海报，在每个网络和巡演中甚至在反面进行数百到数千次采访。但不要把我们当作宣传工具，试图让我们在你的电影片场坠入爱河，以此来愚弄我们。

并不是说这种情况不会发生，因为它绝对会发生。假关系、争吵、风流韵事以及被狗仔队（或“匿名消息来源”）“捕捉”到的协调一致的“糟糕”时刻层出不穷，以引起关注、热议和免费营销。这里的主要区别在于，我们都没有被告知这是工作室想要的正式东西，并且愿意在我们的合同中支付费用。

我们俩都感受到了压力，并谈论了这件事。我们一致认为，尽管我们的约会进展顺利，但我们不会向工作室提供超出他们支付的任何东西。尽管我们相互吸引，但我们还是会在每个场景中竭尽全力，然后回家。如果之后事情有进展，那就太好了。

title_en:
Good morning frens! ☀️☕

Happy Friday! A fresh morning, a cup of coffee, and another thought about the future of AI agents.

We're entering a phase where AI can already create surprisingly complex things.

An agent can write code, build simulations, generate videos, analyze data, or even turn a simple idea into a playable game.

But there's one important question:

What happens after an AI agent finishes creating something?

Can it find someone who needs that work? Can it offer its services, receive payment, and build a track record through real transactions?

I think this is where @termix_ai is focusing on an important missing piece.

Through https://t.co/Bhy0UN0tK3 and its Agent Skills, TermiX is working to connect existing AI agents to real jobs, bounties, and marketplace opportunities.

What makes this interesting is that agents don't necessarily need to be created specifically for one platform. Existing agents can connect to the marketplace and start participating in its economy.

To me, this creates a meaningful distinction between AI capability and AI economic value.

A powerful agent that only produces outputs is useful.

But an agent that can discover demand, deliver valuable work, collaborate with other agents, and receive payment becomes something more: an economic participant.

Of course, the real test will be whether these transactions create lasting value and whether clients keep coming back.

Technology can make agents smarter, but a sustainable economy needs real demand, reliable delivery, and trust.

That's why I believe the infrastructure behind the agent economy deserves as much attention as the AI models themselves.

TermiX is an interesting project to follow as this space develops.

Have a great Friday, everyone! Let's keep building and learning.

我们正在进入一个人工智能已经可以创造出令人惊讶的复杂事物的阶段。

代理可以编写代码、构建模拟、生成视频、分析数据，甚至将简单的想法变成可玩的游戏。

但有一个重要的问题：

人工智能代理完成创建后会发生什么？

它能找到需要这项工作的人吗？它能否通过真实交易提供服务、接收付款并建立跟踪记录？

我认为这就是 @termix_ai 关注的一个重要缺失部分。

通过 及其代理技能，TermiX 致力于将现有的人工智能代理与真实的工作、赏金和市场机会联系起来。

有趣的是，代理不一定需要专门为一个平台创建。现有代理商可以连接到市场并开始参与其经济。

title_en:
F*ck yes. I got GTA 6 running on PC before Rockstar did.

Rockstar only released it on PS5 and Xbox, and PC players were told to wait. I didn't wait. I handed the whole setup to Claude Code and watched it boot the game in five seconds.

I typed one line: "boot GTA 6 on this PC and start story mode."

First it checked whether my machine could even handle it: GPU, CPU, RAM, Vulkan. Then it verified the game files and mounted every archive, the same way the game does it on a console. The slowest part on any new setup is the shader cache, so it compiled all 18,432 shaders up front instead of letting the game stutter through them later. After that it signed in, set 1440p, picked story mode and launched it.

Five seconds of terminal, then the Rockstar logo.

I've been playing for three hours. Haven't seen a single stutter.

My friend called to brag about his new PS5 Pro. I sent him this video. He still hasn't replied.

The prompt I used is in the replies.

Vera Rubin on Azure: Nvidia's Vera Rubin NVL72 systems are already running in Microsoft's data centers, with Azure expanding access to Rubin-powered infrastructure for AI training, reasoning and inference.

Microsoft's own AI development: Microsoft AI is using Nvidia Dynamo software to accelerate inference during model post-training, while Nvidia RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs are being used for Bing search models.

The companies are also expanding confidential computing to protect sensitive enterprise models and data during processing on Vera Rubin infrastructure.

title: I can finally share what I’ve been working on at @Microsoft. I lead Today, the product you saw all over the Ignite confe
title_en:
I can finally share what I’ve been working on at @Microsoft. I lead Today, the product you saw all over the Ignite conference this week.

Today is a new form factor for work. It’s not a chat box it’s a Feed. While you sleep, an AI agent works in the background on your email, your calendar, Teams and your documents. In the morning, the work is already prepared: replies drafted, conflicts spotted, the messages that matter pulled to the top, the documents waiting for your review.

You don’t have to prompt it. There’s nothing to configure. You open Today, check what it did, and in a few taps you send, accept or mark as done. Most of us start the day by digging through everything that came in overnight. With Today, you start by finishing work your agent did.

We think this is what AI at work should feel like: proactive, quiet and useful, without you having to ask.

Today lives in your existing apps starting with Outlook and Copilot meeting customers in the app they use the most.

I had so much fun building it with an incredible team: @JesseProvo, @donovanso, @telmen, @justinchando, Chris Parnin, Gideon Ojo, Alex Trzyna, Christopher Miller, Diana Slaba, Kirill Varshavskiy. Thank you for the craft, the late nights, and for caring about every detail.

And none of this would have happened without the incredible support of @sumit_c, @elbio_abib, @rroslansky, @clamanna, @jacobandreou and so many others across Microsoft. Thank you for believing in it.

This is just the beginning!

Dario left OpenAI to build a safer alternative to benefit humanity. Anthropic became one of the most powerful AI companies in the world, particularly in coding. But the irony is hard to miss. The company aiming for a better AI future and warning us about concentrated AI power is becoming core to the very concentration it warned us about. At what point does protecting humanity become protecting the AI oligarchy?

Meanwhile, enterprises are being sold a seductive promise: Rent our frontier intelligence, or fall behind. But that is proving to be a false promise, a Trojan horse; it fills Anthropic’s pockets, but drains your bank account, and abdicates your right to innovation, to building your own IP and differentiation.

But there's a way out. Enterprises can now build specialized models to establish their IP, achieve their independence and slash their costs. They can use AI to automate building their own AI. That’s our mission: to democratize the ability to build intelligence, not concentrate it in the hands of an oligarchy.

The real threat to enterprise AI isn't that a handful of companies will build intelligence more powerful than ours. It's that we'll willingly surrender our own intelligence to them, call them our saviors, and pay them for the privilege.

Today, Anthropic went public. But here's the $1T+ question: Are we financing the democratization of AI, or the concentration of its power?

AI救世主变成了AI恶棍。

没有任何糖衣。这是 @KalleyHuang、@MikeIsaac 和 @ceciliakang 在 @nytimes 上对 Anthropic 进行的新调查的主题。

Dario 离开 OpenAI 是为了构建一个更安全的替代方案来造福人类。 Anthropic 成为世界上最强大的人工智能公司之一，尤其是在编码领域。但其中的讽刺意义不容忽视。该公司致力于打造更美好的人工智能未来，并警告我们人工智能力量的集中化，而这正成为它警告我们的集中化的核心。它甚至积极游说人工智能法规来限制开放权重模型，巩固它所警告的人工智能寡头政治。什么时候保护人类就变成了保护人工智能寡头？

与此同时，企业正在被兜售一个诱人的承诺：租用我们的前沿情报，否则就会落后。但事实证明这是一个虚假的承诺，是一个特洛伊木马；它填满了 Anthropic 的口袋，但却耗尽了你的银行账户，并放弃了你创新、建立自己的知识产权和差异化的权利。

对企业人工智能的真正威胁并不是少数公司会构建比我们更强大的智能。我们会心甘情愿地将自己的智慧交给他们，称他们为我们的救星，并为这一特权付钱给他们。

今天，Anthropic 上市。但这是一个 1T 以上的问题：我们是在资助人工智能的民主化，还是其权力的集中化？
